name: Fidelity Rewards Visa Signature Card

base_rate.description: 2 Points per $1 in eligible net purchases.

rewards.redemption_notes: The 2% cash back value applies only to Points redeemed as a deposit into an eligible Fidelity account; Points can also go to travel, merchandise, gift cards or a statement credit.

benefits.title: Global Entry or TSA PreCheck credit
benefits.description: Up to $100 in Reward Points when you pay the Global Entry or TSA PreCheck application fee with the card.

benefits.title: Auto Rental Collision Damage Waiver
benefits.description: Auto Rental Collision Damage Waiver for up to $75,000.

notes: Elan Financial Services reviews applications and services the account; Fidelity is not involved in credit decisions. APRs are not stated on the product page, so they are null.
